title: Environmental data logger (different device, dual-bus, larger board)
goal: A compact environmental data logger: a BME280 temperature/humidity/pressure sensor on I2C, a microSD card on SPI for storage, powered by a 3.3 V LDO from a 5 V USB input, with a coin-cell-backed RTC. Board must fit within 40 x 30 mm and have two mounting holes.

requirements: interfaces stated (I2C for sensor, SPI for microSD)
input/output voltages quantified (5 V in, 3.3 V rail)
board size constraint stated (40 x 30 mm)
design: board outline / mechanical envelope authored and committed
electronics: schematic topology defined (BME280 + microSD + LDO + RTC)
key components selected for THIS product (not an IMU breakout)
firmware: BME280 I2C read + microSD SPI write approach noted
simulation: ERC/DRC or a design check noted
